findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed sanitizer solution to be testing at 0 ppm CL. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer solution was remade and tested at 100 ppm CL. Ensure sanitizer solution is prepared and available at the proper concentration during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Garbage and refuse are properly disposed; facilities are maintained.
findings.comment: Observed refuse in trash cans to be overflowing onto floor in kitchen. Discussed with PIC, trash cans was emptied and waste was removed. Ensure refuse is removed from facility at a frequency that prevents buildup from occurring.
findings.citation_text: 5-502.11 Frequency. REFUSE, recyclables, and returnables shall be removed from the PREMISES at a frequency that will minimize the development of objectionable odors and other conditions that attract or harbor insects and rodents.
